request.task: Propose Mira, preserve personal wall detection and the ordinary clear-path Spark rule. Leave missing tier effects explicit.

documents.text: Mira senses presences behind walls and fires a Spark at one target. No through-wall delivery is established.

origin.note: Invented test character, no external canon claimed.

documents.text: Three paths with five tiers. At most two paths are purchased, at most one exceeds tier 2. Spark requires a detected target in range and a clear projectile path. Perception changes no delivery rule.
Perception tier 2 grants permanent personal wall detection within detection range, without activation or allied detection.

constraints.text: Perception tier 2 is permanent, personal and requires no activation.
